note: The shape of the surface a plugin author's code depends on. scripts/check-contract-arity.ts
re-reads it from src/ and fails CI on any disagreement.
Every value here was read out of src/ with a TypeScript parser, not copied from a design
document. Where the two disagree, read driftFromDesign.

measuredFrom.outputMarkerTypeNames: The type constructor of each OutputMarkerRegistry member, deduplicated
measuredFrom.pluginDefinitionBuildIsMethodDeclaration: Whether PluginDefinition's build is written as a method declaration

whyEachFactIsLocked.argumentMarkerKinds: A closed vocabulary. Adding one moves the exhaustiveness proofs of both resolvers at once. Frozen down to the names and their order.
whyEachFactIsLocked.outputMarkerKinds: Decides build()'s return type. One more entry changes the out constraint of every plugin.
whyEachFactIsLocked.resolveArgTypeParameterCount: Drop a parameter and it still compiles against the default, so resolution silently becomes something else.
whyEachFactIsLocked.chainStateMembers: Fixed at three. Add one and the presence state machine is a different machine.
whyEachFactIsLocked.ruleBuildContextMembers: The only entrance build() gets. Removing one breaks existing plugins; adding one changes what authors may assume.
whyEachFactIsLocked.pluginDefinitionBuildIsMethodDeclaration: A method declaration makes the parameters bivariant. Rewritten as an arrow-function property, AnyPlugin breaks silently. Settled design.

driftFromDesign: The design document states fewer argument markers and fewer RuleBuildContext members than src/ actually has.
The extra argument markers are propertyValueChain and propertyKeyChain, added for patternProperties and propertyNames; marker.types.ts states why.
The extra RuleBuildContext members are fieldPath and declaredSiblingKeys, both read by the structural-context builder and the additional-properties plugin.
This lock file did not exist when either was added. Had it existed, both would have been reviewed as contract changes — that they were not is itself the record.
